name: Camp Mansfield
description_short: A town run outdoor day camp for children entering kindergarten through 9th grade, 9 am to 3 pm, at Mansfield Middle School, Schoolhouse Brook Park and Bicentennial Pond. Campers do archery, canoeing and kayaking, swimming, sports, nature and crafts in weekly themes; there is a half day KinderCamp for kindergarten and field trips for the 7th to 9th grade group.
special_needs_notes: Campers who need extra support or adaptations take part with their own age group; a special assistance form is due at least 15 working days before the session.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Camp Mansfield 2026 page. Prices are the non-resident Explorers (grades K to 6) rates: $164 for 3 day Session 1, $216 for 4 day Session 2, $267 a week after; residents pay $154, $206 and $257. KinderCamp (half day) is $90 to $143 and Adventurers (grades 7 to 9) $201 to $328 non-resident. AM, PM and combined camp care cost extra. Three daily lunch choices are included for full day campers. Camp Mansfield Assistance application available. Grades are the grade entering in fall. The page gives no street address or zip for the middle school; forms go to the Community Center, 10 S. Eagleville Road, Storrs, CT 06268.
